## Statement

Imported vocabulary, as the source describes it: a task is a set of input and output attribute pairs of a substrate; a constructor is a system that brings the output about and remains able to do so again; a task is possible when some constructor can perform it to any desired accuracy and not possible otherwise. The repository uses none of this vocabulary as a primitive.

## Governing obligation

Taking the possible and not-possible partition of tasks as primitive is a different foundational choice from the repository's admitted primitive PG-ROOT-DIFF-STRUCTURE and its replayed refusal predicates. No source derives either from the other.

## Source status

Taken from the cited source as an assumption of this branch; the source's own hypotheses and exact wording are not audited here.

## What is imported

- Tasks as sets of input/output attribute pairs; constructors that stay able to repeat the task; possibility as existence of a constructor to arbitrary accuracy.

Declared imported structure:
- `task / constructor / possible-task vocabulary (assumption)`
